spans.s:
केकय m. (-यः) A prince of the lunar race.
 f. (-यी) daughter of the prece-
ding and one of the wives of DAŚARATHA: the mother of
BHARATA: see केकेयी.

केकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Squint-eyed.
 E. के in the head. कृ to make, टच्
affix; also compounded with अक्ष an eye, as केकराक्ष.

केका f. (-का) The cry of a peacock.
 E. के an imitative sound and क
what sounds, from कै to sound, affixes ड and टाप्.

केकाबल m. (-लः) A peacock.
 E. केका his cry, and बलच् aff.

केकिन् m. (-की) A peacock.
 E. केका the cry of the bird, and इनि aff.

केकेयी f. (-यी) One of DASARAT'HA'S three wives, the mother of
BHARATA.
